model.name: deploymentRefs become a real typed OOP model (interfaces + inheritance, IOR relationships to file-leaf nodes)
model.description: The WODA.prod deploymentRefs (today an ad-hoc array of {role, ref:'ior:file:...', note} STRING refs) become a real OOP model: each ref a first-class TYPED unit related by TYPED IOR relationships (deploys/contains/manifestsAs/configuredBy), a genuine inheritance hierarchy with interfaces (abstract deployment-target -> Device/ExecutionEnvironment/Service; Artifact -> ConfigFile/Certificate/KeyFile/EnvValue), each leaf resolving to a real file on disk. Reuses the existing M2 family (no parallel type system).
model.tronQuote: just ior relationships to uml deployment diagram nodes that basically end in files - think oop interfaces and inheritance scenario-first

acceptanceCriteria.text: [AUTOMATABLE, graph] Each ref is a FIRST-CLASS typed unit (an ior:class:ModelElement instanceOf its deployment-type), NOT a string in an array.
[AUTOMATABLE, graph] Refs are related by TYPED IOR relationships (deploys / contains / manifestsAs / configuredBy), NOT a free-text 'role' string.

[AUTOMATABLE, graph] A genuine inheritance hierarchy with interfaces exists: abstract deployment-target -> Device / ExecutionEnvironment / Service; Artifact -> ConfigFile / Certificate / KeyFile / EnvValue.

[AUTOMATABLE, graph, anti-DRY-claim] GENERALIZATION is FIRST-CLASS + QUERYABLE: a gate asserts ConfigFile IS-A Artifact by READING THE GRAPH — generalization/realization are TYPED relationships or explicit model fields (exactly as deploys/contains/manifestsAs/configuredBy already are), NOT names/notes. If the IS-A can only be read from a string/name, it is DRY-claimed-not-enforced = FAIL (the sprintLabel-comment disease).

[AUTOMATABLE, graph] INTERFACES exist as first-class REALIZABLE contracts (distinct from abstract-base single-inheritance; an interface is satisfiable ACROSS unrelated branches): FileBacked (every artifact whose leaf manifestsAs a real file — all 4 subtypes realize it), Deployable (targets that can host), optionally Measurable (has a verifiable on-disk referent). Realization is QUERYABLE the same way as generalization (typed relationship/field, read from the graph across branches).

[AUTOMATABLE, disk, ★ THE INVARIANT] Every FileBacked leaf RESOLVES to a real file on disk — and this passes AS A MODEL QUERY: enumerate the FileBacked realizers from the GRAPH, resolve each leafs manifestsAs->ior:file:, os.path.exists ALL. This is what makes Trons basically-end-in-files PROVABLE (not a description); a hierarchy whose leaves point at nothing is the fabricated-reference class killed 5x this sprint.
[AUTOMATABLE, graph+disk] All 4 existing refs survive the migration as proper typed nodes: sshd_config · host key · .env#LE_DOMAIN · LE fullchain — none lost, each now a typed unit.
[AUTOMATABLE, graph] The types reuse the existing M2 metamodel family (a1d2e3f4-... sentinels) — NO parallel type system; the deployment-node facet already added (R40.2 UmlNode) extends, not forks.
[AUTOMATABLE] INV-T byte-diff==0 — the typed model is compute-on-read / a structural migration that does not churn unrelated units.
